Beautiful space, good service
Sep 2023 • Couples
The restaurant space is beautiful and very romantic, suitable for couples on dates or special occasions. Like I had dinner with the whole family that day.
Service here is very good, attentive and enthusiastic from the time I got off the bus until I paid and when I left.
The food is delicious, suitable for taste, and the price is also very reasonable.
Beef steak is also very delicious, with many degrees of doneness to choose from. Very suitable for sharing wine, there are many types of wine here, very easy to choose.
